sourceInterpretation: Retained danger assessment asks main findReadyUnits for candidates and passes those to doUGL. Installed main filtering does not categorically remove the leader; doUGL picks a local nonplayer launcher carrier.
CBE previously removed every leader before any ammunition/launcher check, leaving leader-only flare groups without an admission path.
This compares the separately preserved danger and installed-main snapshots, not a whole-version parity claim.
implementation: Reorder the existing first16 candidates so a leader already present is last. Preserve all original candidates and their search budget.
Remove only the categorical leader exclusion. Idle/native target, readiness/planner, reservation, locality/ROE and all current loading/aim/fire/cleanup checks are unchanged.
Leader outside the original prefix remains outside; player or busy leaders remain ineligible.
No new movement, leadership, inventory, dummy-target, knowledge or physics command.
sourceMethodsNotCopied: Source doUGL forces stop, posture and forceMove; it also creates/reveals a dummy target and directly replaces magazine inventory. CBE retains its existing native no-dummy/no-inventory-edit finite executor.
Source fire callback delay does not prove release. CBE still requires the actual matching FiredMan observation and native weapon readback.
cost: Reorder at most16 existing entries. One selection-time leader read replaces the prior per-initially-eligible-actor reads; when none qualifies this adds one read. No worker/timer/world query; no universal speedup or measured runtime delta claimed.
limitations: Audits paused; actual aim, release, effect, interruption and weapon handback unverified.
Native STOP/WAIT admission deliberately unchanged; this is not general holding-team illumination.
Whole LAMBS functionality/parity and measured performance are not established.
Raw reference sources remain private and untouched; no upstream assets copied into product.
